parent_attribution_methodology.definition: parent_ts is the timestamp of the 5m chart bar on which request.security_lower_tf delivered that LTF array element. It is TradingView's own attribution, observed, not computed.
parent_attribution_methodology.observed_two_ways: published by the probe as plot `pt` (Pine `time`), and independently available as the study series' own bar time; the two agreed on every parent (0 mismatches).
parent_attribution_methodology.never_reconstructed: parent_ts is NEVER derived from timestamp geometry. The floor rule `timestamp - (timestamp % 300)` disagrees with the recorded attribution on 11,912 of 29,780 rows (40.0%) for BOTH instruments.
parent_attribution_methodology.straddling: 3 does not divide 5, so a 3m bar may straddle a 5m boundary. Every bar overlaps its recorded parent, and no bar was returned under two parents (0 duplicates).
